title: HiFlow: Hierarchical Feedback-Driven Optimization for Constrained Long-Form Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2603.04996v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models face a multi-objective optimization problem in constrained long-text generation, balancing global structure, local coherence, and constraint satisfaction. We propose LoopWeaver, a hierarchical workflow with two sequential offline preference-optimization stages. Constraint-aware planning produces structured plans, feasibility filtering removes invalid plans, and a shared deterministic reward constructs preference pairs for plan-level and generation-level DPO. At inference time, LoopWeaver remains feed-forward: it generates and revises a complete plan, filters the revised plan, and then generates segments conditioned on the current sub-plan and running narrative. We evaluate the method on four LongGenBench-style structured scenarios across multiple backbones. Results show improvements in both constraint accuracy and text quality across all four open-source backbones. Our software and data are publicly available at

translated_title: HiFlow：面向受约束长文本生成的分层反馈驱动优化
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在受约束的长文本生成中面临多目标优化问题，需要平衡全局结构、局部连贯性与约束满足度。我们提出了LoopWeaver，一个包含两个顺序进行的离线偏好优化阶段的分层工作流。其中，约束感知规划生成结构化计划，可行性过滤去除无效计划，共享的确定性奖励机制为计划级和生成级的DPO构建偏好对。在推理阶段，LoopWeaver保持前馈式运行：先生成并修订一个完整计划，过滤修订后的计划，然后基于当前子计划和已生成的叙事内容逐段生成文本。我们在四个LongGenBench风格的结构化场景上，跨多个骨干模型对该方法进行了评估。结果显示，在全部四个开源骨干模型上，约束准确性和文本质量均得到提升。我们的软件和数据已公开发布于
tldr: 该论文提出了一种分层工作流方法，通过约束感知规划、可行性过滤以及计划级与生成级的DPO偏好优化，在受约束长文本生成任务中同时提升了约束满足度和文本质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical workflow that combines constraint-aware planning, feasibility filtering, and plan-level and generation-level DPO preference optimization to improve both constraint satisfaction and text quality in constrained long-form text generation.
